source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Supplies authority as the implied object of give and preserves both numbers and clothing.
key_decisions.before: And I will grant authority to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”
key_decisions.after: I will give authority to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, dressed in sackcloth.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I will grant authority to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the two symbolic names and crucifixion clue without substituting a city name.
key_decisions.before: and their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city that is symbolically called Sodom and Egypt, where their Lord was crucified.
key_decisions.after: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city, spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, where their Lord was also crucified.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city that is symbolically called Sodom and Egypt, where their Lord was crucified.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows they heard rather than I heard and keeps the watching enemies.
key_decisions.before: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” And they went up to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.
key_decisions.after: They heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up to heaven in the cloud, and their enemies watched them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” And they went up to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the singular kingdom and he without resolving the final pronoun to a substituted name.
key_decisions.before: Then the seventh angel sounded, and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he shall reign forever and ever.”
key_decisions.after: The seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices in heaven said: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will reign forever and ever.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then the seventh angel sounded, and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he shall reign forever and ever.”

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned two-part time formula without adding who is coming.

key_decisions.after: saying: “We thank you, Lord God, the Almighty, who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and begun to reign.
